# TheGreensolve

> TheGreensolve helps companies measure Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, organize supporting evidence, assess decarbonization projects and prepare inventories for expert review.

## Main pages

- [Baseline](https://thegreensolve.com/): Carbon intelligence platform for GHG inventory, baseline comparison, project screening, evidence collection and TGS review.
- [The Baseline Journal](https://thegreensolve.com/blog): Practical carbon accounting, reporting and carbon-market guidance for small and mid-sized companies.
- [Net-Low](https://thegreensolve.com/netlow): Employee sustainability engagement and activity reporting.
